labels: Amplified repeats,separated by size on a gel, give a DNA fingerprint
note: Caption left empty: the 'Figure 5.16 Schematic representation of DNA fingerprinting...' caption sits in the tinted panel below target_box_in_crop and belongs to a separate block. Also excluded (outside the box or not figure content): running header 'MOLECULAR BASIS OF INHERITANCE', page decoration, and the diagonal '(c) NCERT not to be republished' watermark. Structure lost in the flat list: individuals A and B each show paired paternal/maternal chromosomes 7, 2 and 16 (left column A, right column B) feeding via arrows into gel lanes A and B; crime-scene DNA (C, bottom left, with a 0-11 'Number of short tandem repeats' scale bar) feeds gel lane C; gel numbers 12 down to 1 are the vertical axis titled 'Number of short tandem repeats'. The second 'Chromosome 7/2/16' trio of labels belongs to individual B, the final trio to crime scene C. The printed text 'repeats,separated' has no space after the comma and is kept as printed.
